units.rawText: Since a long time ago, people used to say I wasn't like the others... Frankly speaking, I was aware of that, but I had no intention of changing myself or letting myself be changed.

units.rawText: However, the Oasis seems to have accepted someone like me easily enough. At times, I wish I could stay here forever.
